svg.title: Spaces and optional Cloud space management
svg.desc: The local app implements start and move requests to Cloud. Space management and ordinary space participation have separate authority. Move archives go from the local server directly to the returned space upload target. Imports and optional configured OIDC are implemented. Server takedown and evidence operations are explicit exceptions to ordinary content access. Contract support does not establish space-management deployment availability.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local DorkOS app + server
Start / move UI + Cloud relay implemented
Agents execute here
